items.q: He was of major symphony caliber, but he couldn't get a job

ctx.x: What do you think about Richard Davis?

Beautiful, very -- he had been denied his talents long ago. He was of major symphony caliber, but he couldn't get a job, so he went his various ways of trying to find a spot for himself, which he has, for master musician, master bassist.
